Do exactly this:
F1 (Medium, must): add a test (a new SV-9g, or an extension of SV-9a) that serves a /3 file with leads enabled and NO leads.whatsapp (a new sample file or a copy of ok-office-a without the field, written by the test into its temporary folder) and checks `whatsapp: null` is in the answer for ru, kk and en as the second key of `leads` (key order as the design says), and the same through publicQuestionnaire on a view without the field. F2 (Low): in LK-5a add the desk cases [1,"x","-",4] and [1,null,"-","-"] (a wrong desk value before a missing desk) with literal expected lines (two lines for the first: E_FIELD at questions[1].desk and E_FIELD "Стол задан не у всех вопросов" at questions[2].desk per the design message texts; take the exact texts from the design M-list). Then run `cd tools && npm run check` once: it must be green with zero red; report the new test count. Put the three mutant runs into result.self_check. Close the handoff COMPLETED.
